mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.1%) compresses discount rates and stimulates investment, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. This effect is persistent across market cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE > 0.3pp in 3 months) signals economic weakness, leading to negative equity returns as corporate earnings face downward pressure.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and real consumption (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns due to reduced consumer spending and business investment.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS decline in the same month, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime (INDPRO < 100), industrial output stagnation leads to inflationary pressures and negative equity returns as corporate margins face cost-push inflation.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 100, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 45% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts (HOUST > 5% decline in 3 months) reflects weakening consumer demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns due to reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: When HOUST falls > 5% in 3 months, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in job growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signal labor market deterioration, driving negative equity returns through reduced consumer spending and corporate hiring cuts.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises in the same month, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 270), the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten policy aggressively, causing negative S&P 500 returns due to higher discount rates and reduced corporate investment.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 270, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 45% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of real personal consumption (RSAFS above 5-year average) indicates strong consumer demand, supporting corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS is above its 5-year moving average, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.
